name: @powerduck/datamodel
description: Browser-safe relational modeling core for OpenAPI: extract entities and foreign keys from an OpenAPI document, derive many-to-many link tables with composite keys from array references, generate dialect-aware DDL/indexes/seed SQL, diff a model against a live database, reverse-engineer component schemas, and build a versioned, AI-ready ER reconciliation artifact (JSON + Markdown/Mermaid). Pure functions only; no React, DOM, filesystem or runtime dependencies.

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm run test && npm run check:dual

author: POWERDUCK LIMITED
